purpose: Analyze proposition-level meaning in songs whose primary value is reasoning, judgment, boundary-setting, governance, causality, or reflective statements rather than affect.
principle: Emotion is not mandatory evidence. Rational songs may carry weak affect but strong propositions.

analysis_dimensions.label: 主張／論點
analysis_dimensions.description: The sentence or idea the song asserts as true or worth adopting.

analysis_dimensions.label: 理由／依據
analysis_dimensions.description: Why the claim is made; supporting rationale.

analysis_dimensions.label: 因果
analysis_dimensions.description: What leads to what; causal or consequence structure.

analysis_dimensions.label: 條件
analysis_dimensions.description: If/when/unless-style conditions that constrain the claim.

analysis_dimensions.label: 界線
analysis_dimensions.description: Limits, rights, responsibilities, refusal, distance, or non-negotiables.

analysis_dimensions.label: 治理
analysis_dimensions.description: Self-management, choice, responsibility, closure, restraint, or direction-setting.

analysis_dimensions.label: 關係規則
analysis_dimensions.description: Mutuality, reciprocity, alignment, interaction, or relationship requirements.

analysis_dimensions.label: 判斷
analysis_dimensions.description: A conclusion about a situation, person, behavior, or value.

analysis_dimensions.label: 反轉／重框
analysis_dimensions.description: Reframes a familiar idea by inversion, contrast, pun, or semantic reversal.

analysis_dimensions.label: 結論
analysis_dimensions.description: The final distilled proposition reached by the song.

suggested_tags: 過去可以回味但不等於停留
retrieval_rule: For rational-discourse songs, reasoning_tags and key_propositions should have equal or greater retrieval importance than emotion tags.

loc_relationship.LOC7: proposition structure, text architecture, retrieval and vectorization

final_state_optional.rule: A descriptive/process song may be semantically complete without a final state.

classical_chinese.rule: Classical Chinese lyrics require an interpretation layer before keyword tagging.

reasoning_discourse.label: 思辨論述型
reasoning_discourse.definition: 歌曲以觀點、道理、判斷、因果、關係規則、界線、存在體悟或治理命題為主要語意骨架；情緒可以存在，但不是主要組織方式。
reasoning_discourse.distinction_from_governance_declaration: 治理宣言型聚焦自我治理、界線與行動規範；思辨論述型可涵蓋更廣的關係、存在、價值與概念推理。
reasoning_discourse.completion_rule: When an existing category is 其他／待複查 or 轉折型候選 and the work is author-confirmed as a rational reasoning mode, category may resolve to 思辨論述型.
